clusters.label: Thermodiffusion effect
clusters.definition: Temperature-driven ionic redistribution contributing to ionic thermoelectric response.
clusters.reason: Both describe ionic thermodiffusion; selective pathways and accompanying thermoextraction remain separate claim context.

unresolved.reason: Electrical transport optimization is reported without identifying the optimized quantities or state sufficiently to establish equivalence.
Carrier concentration and band flattening explain optimization, but the resulting electrical transport properties are insufficiently specified for equivalence.

clusters.label: Vickers hardness
clusters.definition: Mechanical hardness quantified by the Vickers indentation measure.
clusters.reason: All explicitly identify the same hardness quantity. Materials, dopants, strengthening mechanisms and variation directions belong to individual claims.

clusters.label: Ionic bond character

clusters.reason: Both describe the same bonding descriptor using QTAIM; the particular bonds and compounds remain claim-specific.

clusters.label: Large lattice distortion

clusters.reason: Both denote the structural distortion itself; its material-specific origins, accompanying defects and consequences do not change that concept.

clusters.label: High figure of merit

clusters.reason: All refer to high thermoelectric figure of merit from computational investigations, without specifying distinct subtypes. No numerical equality is implied.

clusters.label: High thermoelectric efficiency

clusters.reason: Both describe the same predicted performance outcome; different supporting transport properties remain attached to their claims.

clusters.label: Reciprocal charge-transfer resistance
clusters.definition: The inverse of electrochemical charge-transfer resistance, 1/Rct.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify the same reciprocal resistance quantity; redox species and electrode-thickness regimes remain distinct claim conditions.

clusters.label: Reciprocal diffusion resistance
clusters.definition: The inverse of electrochemical diffusion resistance, 1/Rdif.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify the same reciprocal diffusion-resistance quantity, despite different electrolyte species and thickness conditions.

clusters.label: O vacancies

clusters.reason: Both denote oxygen vacancies in BiCuSeO. Charge compensation and thermal-conductivity reduction are different effects of the same defect concept.

clusters.label: Bi vacancies

clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify bismuth vacancies associated with holes; sample compositions and joint contributions remain claim-specific.

clusters.label: Conduction band

clusters.reason: All denote the conduction band as an electronic-structure concept. Distinct orbital contributions and chemical species describe each material's band, without establishing material identity.

clusters.label: Valence band
clusters.definition: The electronic valence-band region identified in the supplied electronic-structure studies.
clusters.reason: All denote the same band concept; material compositions and dominant or hybridized orbital contributions remain properties of individual claims.

clusters.label: Ba3GeO

clusters.reason: Its Ge-containing composition distinguishes it from Ba3SiO; parentheses pair separate materials and results.

clusters.label: Ba3SiO

clusters.reason: Its Si-containing composition distinguishes it from Ba3GeO; the supplied evidence reports separate temperature ranges and ZT values.

clusters.label: High sensitivity to temperature variations

clusters.reason: Both explicitly use the Seebeck coefficient to infer the same sensitivity outcome. Numerical values and assertion strengths remain claim-specific.

clusters.label: Stable cubic structure

clusters.reason: Both denote the same general structural descriptor, without asserting identical compositions, crystal structures or stability tests.
